headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 28, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 13.75% compared to SPY's 9.40%. This results in an average alpha of 4.35%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a substantial return of 45.63%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 6.54%, highlighting a notable disparity within the portfolio set. This outperformance is particularly relevant during times of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market movements. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
